entries.statutory_rationale: German StVO dual-carriageway roads with separated lanes have no general statutory car speed ceiling (advisory 130 km/h), encoded as ETS2 limit 0.
German StVO Autobahn advisory speed (Richtgeschwindigkeit 130 km/h) has no general statutory ceiling, encoded as ETS2 limit 0.
